name: Plimsoll Line (Calm To Do List & Tasks)

mentions.name: Plimsoll Line (Calm To Do List & Tasks)
mentions.description: An iOS to-do and task app that eases anxiety from mountains of reminder items by surfacing stress factors and offering small actions such as quick journalling and a breathing exercise. Version 1 is live on the iOS App Store and a new version with a widget is due for release within the next couple of weeks.
mentions.problem: People get overwhelmed and emotionally worn down by long lists of things they have yet to do but haven't started; the app surfaces stress factors and breaks the cycle of emotional decay through small actions.
mentions.audience: Overwhelmed people dealing with long unstarted to-do lists, built for the author's wife and himself
mentions.source_excerpt: 1.
